descriptionChirho: The Canaanite city Taanach (modern Tell Ta'annek), mentioned in conquest narratives and Levitical city lists. All 7 occurrences refer to the same location. S145550 covers standalone forms in various syntactic positions (eng 'Taanach/Taanakh', spa 'Taanac/Taanak', arb 'تَعْنَكَ', kor '다아낙', swa 'Taanaki', hin 'तानाक/तानक'). S145552 has the bet preposition (eng 'at Taanach', spa 'en Taanak', arb 'بِتَعْنَكَ', kor '다아냅에서', swa 'katika Taanaki', hin 'तअनाक में'). The split is purely grammatical — prepositional prefix — not a different place or meaning.
